title: Loop Detection

story.briefing: A maintenance drone went into the chain and never came out. If the links form a circle, anything following them walks forever.
story.success: Loop confirmed and mapped. The drone is recovered.

description: Using the same chain format — an array of [value, next] nodes and a head index — return true if following the links from the head ever revisits a node, and false if the chain reaches -1 and ends. An empty chain returns false.

examples.explanation: Node 0 points to 1, which points back to 0.

hints: You cannot simply walk to the end, because if there is a loop there is no end. You need a way to notice you have been somewhere before.
Recording every position you visit works and is a fine answer. There is also a way that needs no extra storage at all, using two probes moving at different speeds.
Advance a slow position one step and a fast position two steps per iteration. If the fast probe ever runs off the end, there is no loop; if the two positions ever coincide, there is.
